rationale_sources: ICML official abstract; analysis.md#32-设计动机矩阵
design_rationales.concrete_problem: Long generations lose earlier image evidence.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Compress and selectively reuse image evidence to preserve visual grounding.
analysis_basis: Official abstract states the problem and intended memory role.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Retain original visual tokens or use retrieval; capacity/accuracy trade-off is unavailable.

rationale_sources: ICML official abstract; analysis.md#32-设计动机矩阵
design_rationales.concrete_problem: Intermediate conclusions and constraints are lost in a growing monolithic context.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Track intermediate conclusions and constraints in a separate latent memory.
analysis_basis: Official abstract states the problem and intended memory role.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Explicit scratchpads or context summarization may be simpler but have different error propagation; unavailable in the paper evidence.

rationale_sources: ICML official abstract; analysis.md#32-设计动机矩阵
design_rationales.concrete_problem: Visual and reasoning information needs vary across inference state.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Select memory type and reuse amount dynamically during inference.
analysis_basis: Official abstract states dynamic memory selection and claimed state dependence.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Fixed mixing or attention fusion avoids routing collapse but may waste compute; measured trade-offs unavailable.

design_rationales.design: frozen base MLLM with three-stage training
rationale_sources: ICML official abstract; analysis.md#32-设计动机矩阵
design_rationales.concrete_problem: Improve long-horizon reasoning with few additional trainable parameters.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Freeze the base model and train latent-memory construction and selective routing in stages.
analysis_basis: Official abstract states frozen base, three stages, and parameter-efficiency objective.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: End-to-end fine-tuning or adapters may offer capacity at greater cost; matched capacity evidence unavailable.
